description: This is an Android Fragment class named MatchListFragment that displays a horizontal, scrollable list of live sports matches with TV focus support. It manages a RecyclerView populated with match data provided by MatchViewModel, and handles navigation to match details upon item selection.

classes.name: MatchListFragment
classes.description: A Fragment showing a horizontally scrollable row of live matches with TV focus, managing UI components and user interaction.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's layout from XML resource 'fragment_match_list'.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes RecyclerView, adapter, layout manager, focus properties, and launches a coroutine to observe match data and update UI accordingly.
